dockerfile_reconstruction:
FROM python:3.13.2-slim
ENV NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 POLARS_MAX_THREADS=1 RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git build-essential && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
WORKDIR /workspace
RUN git init && git remote add origin https://github.com/scikit-bio/scikit-bio.git && git fetch --depth=1 origin e6f51b1ef6de5fba07cb184fa5152ee8920abd87 && git checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
RUN python -m pip install --no-cache-dir -e '.[test]' 'numpy==2.5.3' 'scipy==1.18.1' 'pandas==3.0.6' 'pytest==9.0.3' 'numba==0.68.0' 'llvmlite==0.50.0'
RUN python -m pip freeze --all > /opt/baseline-freeze.txt
RUN mkdir -p /opt/skbio-baseline-extensions && find skbio -type f -name "*.so" -exec cp --parents {} /opt/skbio-baseline-extensions/ \; && find /opt/skbio-baseline-extensions -type f -exec sha256sum {} \; > /opt/skbio-baseline-extension-sha256.txt
test_cmds: cp -a /opt/skbio-baseline-extensions/. /workspace/ && cd /workspace && python -m pytest -o addopts= -v --tb=short skbio/tree/tests/bp/test_bp.py
